description: This is a unit test class for the CleanupPersistence command in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.cleanup package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and deserialization of the CleanupPersistence command.

classes.name: CleanupPersistenceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the CleanupPersistence command, including its immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and deserialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of CleanupPersistence are immutable, including related EntityId instances.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that cleanup persistence objects have correct hashCode and equals implementations.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that JSON input can be correctly deserialized into a CleanupPersistence object.
